coverage.gr_equiv: no stock GR block; golden is a transcription of the published LZ4 Block Format Description, cross-checked BOTH WAYS against the reference C implementation (lz4.block) — it decodes reference-compressed blocks and the reference decodes ours
coverage.patterns: 6 payload classes, 629 bytes, decoded on the AUTO-PLACED + ROUTED + BUILT design on a real simkyt chip through a real SramPanelDevice: all-literal, repetitive text, an offset==1 byte run, an overlapping match, a match-length continuation and a literal continuation; plus reference-C-compressed blocks on the same placed design
coverage.note: SRAM-backed (INV-31), and the first block to address a COMPUTED panel address (wpos - off) into a window it is itself writing. 8 cells: a 3x2 ring over the parse FSM with the egress cell and the controller on a tail — the split that let the emit cell fit its one face flip (INV-46/INV-48). Whole-chip mutations: the first fetch kicking the return entry, a dropped match-length continuation, and an egress hop aimed at the first corridor cell.
